about_the_game:
Fixing The Apocalypse challenges you to define what kind of leader you are, shaping the story based on your ideology. In this mysterious world, every choice you make will come back to you in time, guiding the course of your game. With over 30 different endings, you will experience a truly personalized journey.

Fixing the Apocalypse is a type of political management simulation with a first-person perspective, which is somewhat casual yet deals with serious matters. At times, you will make decisions that leave you in a dilemma, while at other times, you will face different societies and ideologies for the benefit of your city. Some choices will lead you to wars that you need to manage, allowing you to create your own military strategy through turn-based tactical battles. Throughout this journey, your ideology and all context-related decisions will shape your personalized story and determine your ending. You will see world politics through the lens of communities with unique ideologies and religious beliefs, sometimes portrayed with humorous, sometimes with terrifying symbolic narratives.

As the layers of the story unfold, you must balance the needs of your people while proving your tactical genius on the battlefield. Your decisions will not only shape your destiny but also determine the future of the world.
